Configure the Runner

One file sets every option.

The runner reads its settings from one file, in any of three formats.

workers = 4

workers: 4
Warning

Restart the runner after every change.

Line numbers

Long examples show line numbers in a column of their own:

1
2

runner check
runner start --detach

Short ones number each line inline:

1package main
Note

Line numbers are never part of the copied text.
